class: An absolutely positioned element (a screen-reader-only label, a tooltip) inside a horizontal scroll box whose box is not positioned is not clipped by that box: it widens the whole page, so a page that looks contained scrolls sideways on a phone.
mechanism: Adjustment opportunities inbox at 390 px: an sr-only span in the table's last column (position absolute) sat inside div.overflow-x-auto (position static), so the document measured 672 px in a 372 px view.

first_seen.where: GC-MU A5 390 px check in the owner's Chrome
first_seen.evidence: in-frame measurement: docScrollW 672, clientW 372, scrollX 300; the only absolute element right of the view was span.sr-only; wrapper position static

fix: 44cbcb25: the scroll box gets `relative`; after: 372 = 372, scrollX 0.

detection.note: jsdom has no layout; only a real browser at 390 px (an e2e step) can guard it.
